speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing mental status changes; to help me determine the cause, could you please describe exactly what changes you or someone else has noticed?

When did these symptoms first begin, and have they been getting worse over time?

Do you have any history of head injuries, recent infections, or chronic conditions like diabetes or liver disease?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Metabolic Encephalopathy (likely due to smoking-related pulmonary or hepatic compromise)

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Arterial Blood Gas, Liver Function Tests, Ammonia Level, Chest X-Ray.

REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray, Abdomen_CT.
